result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero quantity. The full suite passes offline (607 tests, 0 failures).

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findStockLevelsByWarehouse` (around line 2107). The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use. I also updated its doc comment, which previously said zero quantities were included on purpose.

The quantity lookup (`getQuantity` → `findStockQuantity`) is untouched, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

Only the demo scenario and `StockOverviewTest` call this list, and neither depended on zero rows. Nothing is committed.
